title: Architecture decisions
summary: Choose a proportionate design from the required behavior, existing systems and evidence.

sections.label: Start with the decision
sections.text: Describe the outcome and constraints that the design must satisfy. Identify which decision is needed now and who can accept it. Leave missing business or operating requirements explicit.

sections.label: Compare workable approaches
items: Read the agreed behavior, relevant constraints and evidence about the current system.
Map affected components, interfaces, data ownership and external dependencies.
Compare retaining the current approach with proportionate changes. State tradeoffs in quality, effort, cost and recovery.
Investigate the uncertainty most likely to change the choice, using a small experiment where useful.
Record the selected approach, reasons, alternatives, owner and unresolved questions.

sections.label: When an agent is part of the design
sections.text: Separate the model task from application controls. Define its input, output, permitted tools, checks and failure outcomes. Controller and harness guidance explains this particular architecture concern.

sections.label: Example decision
sections.text: A configuration service might compare extending an existing API with a separate generation job. Request duration, recovery, user feedback and access requirements inform the choice. This example does not establish which approach your project needs.

sections.label: Useful result
sections.text: A decision record and component or interface sketch that another developer can explain and challenge. A list of fashionable tools is not enough to establish architectural fit.

sections.label: Gap review: workflow use and checks
items: Recommended use: Use the existing architecture mapping to make the selected design and its confirmation reviewable.
Record the chosen option, rejected alternatives, owner and unresolved constraints.
Link each material design claim to repository evidence or an explicitly proposed assumption.
Workflow placement and checks are Atlas recommendations. Existing examples, tenant availability, older product claims and comparative benefits were not revalidated by this mapping review.

sections.label: Gap review: verified source contribution
sections.text: The MADR template records context, considered options, a decision and consequences, with an optional confirmation section for checking the decision. This scoped source fact was checked on 15 October 2026. The guide's broader workflow and examples remain Atlas proposals, not demonstrated outcomes.

catalog.applicability: Use when a design choice must be made from agreed behavior, existing systems and evidence, and someone needs to accept it. Record the selected approach, its reasons, the alternatives, the owner and the unresolved questions.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
